summary: Vale S.A. filed a Form 6-K (US equivalent of a foreign private issuer's current report) furnishing its 3Q26 quarterly results release dated October 29, 2026. The filing reports net operating revenues of US$10.6bn, proforma EBITDA of US$3.5bn (down 20% y/y), free cash flow of US$2.2bn, capex of US$1.3bn, and expanded net debt of US$16.4bn. Operational notes include 88.4 Mt iron ore output (-6% y/y), the Serra Sul +20 start-up, Salobo CPF approval, and reaffirmed 2026 guidance. No transaction, ownership change, or special-situation event is disclosed.
